title: docs(documentation): Stop loading files from localhost:8080
body: This will load `instantsearch.css` and `instantsearch.js` from the same host in dev. This only use symlinks to the build files.

comments.body: Don't go too fast at merging :/
This kills the purpose of live-reload, and thus should have removed it as well

Why does it kills the purpose of live-reload? Live-reload still works (and is needed) in dev mode on desktop.

What this PR does is enable testing the dev docs on an ngrok connection (but does not work with livereload)
Live reload no more working for instantsearch.[js,.css]. Still ok for the rest of the website

reverted, broke the whole dev docs workflow.

Remember that the webpack-dev-server is only serving files from memory. We better find a way to load the files on the same domain (but with # port), or do a proxy rewrite rule with guard or anything.

Context: devs wants to be able to debug on mobile and as soon as you load the website on local wifi or ngrok, you cannot have it, it's loading from localhost (cc @redox we said "we will see if it happens" when you did the load from localhost :D)
So, no fix found for now?
I do not have any sadly, I would say only for local temp testing purposes, load the files using the same ngrok hostname/your local ip instead of /localhost/

Hey we can do this maybe:

``` js
  proxy: {
    "/docs/": "http://localhost:4000/instantsearch/"
  },
```

in our webpack.dev config and then access the docs dev from the webpack dev server and serve in the docs dev env /instantsearch.js which will use the webpack dev server auto reload/in memory thing.
